name: ASHWALL NUMBERS: The Tier 1 Daily Draw
description: The oldest continuous numbers operation in the Gray Zone, run by a rotating council of district bookmakers out of a fortified canteen on Ashwall's lower decks. Players pick a three-digit combination for as little as Φ0.50, with payouts drawn from a daily hash of the municipal water-pressure index — a number no corponation can fix. The operation predates the Sable Charter and is considered by many Tier 1 residents to be the closest thing to a community bank they'll ever access.
story_hooks: A player wins a life-changing payout but the bookmakers can't cover it — and the council starts looking for a way to make the problem disappear.
Someone has cracked the water-pressure hash algorithm and is placing winning tickets every day; the underground council needs to find them before Axiom does.
A corporate intelligence operative embeds with the runner network to map the operation's leadership — but starts routing their own salary into the draw.
